description: This file defines functions and a command for configuring and displaying the 'dreaming' mode in the openclaw plugin, including handling user input and updating configuration settings.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> or null if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeDreamingMode
methods.description: Normalizes a string value to a DreamingMode or null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveMemoryCorePluginConfig
methods.description: Extracts the memory-core plugin configuration from the main config.

methods.name: resolveDreamingModeFromConfig
methods.description: Determines the dreaming mode from plugin configuration.

methods.name: updateDreamingModeInConfig
methods.description: Updates the dreaming mode in the main configuration object.

methods.name: formatModeGuideLine
methods.description: Formats a guideline string for a specific dreaming mode.

methods.name: formatModeGuide
methods.description: Generates a string listing all dreaming modes and their guidelines.

methods.name: formatStatus
methods.description: Creates a status string describing current dreaming configuration.

methods.name: formatUsage
methods.description: Creates a usage string for the dreaming command.

methods.name: registerDreamingCommand
methods.description: Registers the 'dreaming' command with the plugin API.
